schema_version.description: This field identifies the data contract version, not a claim of implementation readiness.

language.description: This field selects the requested interface or processing language.

decision_id.description: This identifier refers to one saved semantic decision.

approved_rationale_ids.description: These IDs refer to reviewed explanations that feedback can cite.

correction_option_ids.description: These IDs refer to the reviewed correction alternatives used in feedback.

explanation.description: This flag or object describes explanation requirements or judgments in its parent contract.

status.description: This field states the parent operation result from its declared enumeration.

items.description: These records contain the typed feedback entries defined by this parent object.
